mentions.name: Generic RAG layer
mentions.description: A generic RAG layer combining vector embeddings and full-text search in SQLite with RRF, plus document ingestion layers for 1-2GB knowledge bases, built to power agent context for personal topics like neuroscience, philosophy, and publicly available AI research papers. It lets local models (and even frontier models) churn through a topic without repeated web calls.
mentions.source_excerpt: Generic RAG layer (vector embedding + FTS in SQLite with RRF and document ingestiation layers for 1-2GB knowledge bases to power agent context for stuff I am interested in, neuroscience and philosophy is where I spend time on this right now, and basically every AI research paper publicly available to help agents tinker with local models).
